title: Unleashing the Potential of Neighbors: Diffusion-based Latent Neighbor Generation for Session-based Recommendation

problem.claim: Session-based recommendation predicts the next item anonymous users may be interested in from their current session interactions.

gap.claim: Existing methods typically rely on explicitly observed session data and neglect latent neighbors that may be relevant within the interest space.

narrative_sequence.summary: Defines session-based recommendation as next-item prediction from anonymous users' current session interactions.
Reports that retrieving neighbor sessions can alleviate data sparsity and improve recommendation performance.
Identifies the neglect of latent neighbors as a limitation of existing methods.

unknowns: The supplied units do not describe the proposed diffusion-based latent neighbor generation method.
No experiments, datasets, metrics, quantitative results, or comparisons are supplied.
The supplied units do not state an explicit author-distinguished novelty claim.
